sqlMap.update: update student_application_status set marksstatus = #verificationStatusCode#, reason=#verificationStatusDesc#, verifiedby=#user_id# ,verifiedtime = now() where application_number= #application_number#
sqlMap.select: select application_number from interview_1 i1 join user_program up on up.program_id = i1.program_id join edit_panel_authority epa on epa.user_id = up.user where application_number = #application_number# and up.menu = #menu# and up.user = #user_id#
select up.program_id as programId, pm.program_name as program_name from user_program up join program_master pm on pm.program_id= up.program_id where user = #user_id# order by pm.program_name;

select fc.councelling_status verificationStatusCode, apr.application_number as application_number, es.first_name as first_name, es.category_code as category, es.gender, ep.user_name email, DATE_FORMAT(fc.modification_time, '%d-%m-%Y %H:%i') insert_time from final_candidates fc join final_candidates_to_counselled fcc on fcc.registration_number = fc.registration_number join applicant_program_registration apr on apr.registration_number = fc.registration_number and apr.program_id = fcc.program_id join entity_student es on es.application_number = apr.application_number left join edit_panel_authority ep on ep.user_id = fc.user_id where fcc.program_id = #programId# and fcc.remarks = concat('LIST-', #listNum#) order by fc.councelling_status

select pm.program_id as programId,pm.program_name from applicant_program_registration apr join program_master pm on pm.program_id = apr.program_id where application_number in ( select binded_application_number from student_application_status where application_number =#application_number#);
select pm.program_id as programId,pm.program_name from user_program up join program_master pm on pm.program_id = up.program_id and menu="PW" and user = #user_id#
select application_number from interview_1 where application_number=#application_number# and program_id=#programId#;
select Interview_level as category from program_master where program_id= #programId#;
